newDescription: As a manufacturing engineer, I want an approved CID ghost image for Lenovo ThinkEdge SE10n Gen 2 hardware so that new CIDs can be manufactured and deployed with the approved production software baseline. The image is specific to the validated SE10n Gen 2 configuration and supports the CID 1:1 deployment model. A/C Manufacturing receives a released CID ghost image for Lenovo ThinkEdge SE10n Gen 2 configuration. The image contains the latest approved production Linux Update and CID Agent baseline. It does not contain pre-cached AIC KVM images. Gen 2 performance is compared with a Gen 1 CID using the same representative workflow, and the results are recorded in the ticket before release. The image can be restored (by manufacturing) to other SE10n Gen 2 units with the exact same configuration. A restored unit functions successfully: Restored CID boots without requiring manual intervention. After boot, the CID automatically contacts CID Hub without manual intervention, and its last-connected time is updated on the Devices page. Both network interfaces operate in their assigned Corporate and Instrument roles. A CID created from the image can be activated against the production CID Hub and becomes available for use. The latest approved OpenLab CDS 2.8 and 3.0 images can each be provisioned successfully on a CID created from the ghost image. A supported physical GC/MS or LC/MS instrument can be configured through the Instrument NIC. A representative multi-sample sequence completes successfully, and its results are available in OpenLab CDS without instrument communication failures, interrupted runs, or CID instability. Reset to Factory completes successfully from CID Hub, after which the CID can be activated again. D/N Record the exact Lenovo ThinkEdge SE10n Gen 2 configuration used to create and validate the image, including processor, memory, storage, BIOS version, and network controllers. Compatibility is limited to the recorded configuration. Compatibility with other hardware models or materially different SE10n Gen 2 configurations is not implied. Create the image using the current approved CID production baseline. Configure ac_install.sh to use the production registration server. Do not include pre-cached AIC KVM images. Record the image name and version, release train, software baseline, creation date, checksum, minimum destination-disk size, and restoration instructions in the ticket before release. Validation is scoped to one CID controlling one instrument. Q/N Complete the current DOD for Ghost Images ( . Create the image on one SE10n Gen 2 unit and restore it to a second unit with the same approved configuration. Verify the installed Linux Update and CID Agent versions against the approved production baseline, and confirm that no KVM images are cached. Verify unattended boot, CID Hub connectivity, production activation, and correct Corporate and Instrument NIC assignments after restoration. Provision and validate the latest approved CDS 2.8 and CDS 3.0 images separately. Connect a supported physical GC/MS or LC/MS instrument through the Instrument NIC and complete its normal configuration in OpenLab CDS. Run a representative sequence containing multiple large samples. Monitor for unexpected AIC VM restarts, CID Agent restarts, network interruptions, resource exhaustion, or instrument communication failures. Run the same representative workflow on a Gen 1 CID and record the comparative timings and observations. Run Reset to Factory from CID Hub and verify that the CID can activate again afterward.
